import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Fetch hourly NO2 data for Mong Kok station (station_id 14) for June 2025
query_no2 = text("""
SELECT datetime, no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 14
AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")
df_no2 = pd.read_sql(query_no2, engine)
print(f"NO2 data rows: {len(df_no2)}")

# Fetch traffic congestion data for road segments within 500 metres of the station, focusing on rush hours 08 and 09
query_congestion = text("""
SELECT r.geometry, h.datetime, h.congestion_index
FROM road_segment r
JOIN hourly_road_segment_traffic h ON r.id = h.road_segment_id
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON aqs.id = 14
WHERE ST_DWithin(aqs.coordinate::geography, r.geometry::geography, 500)
AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) IN (8, 9)
AND h.datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND h.datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
""")
df_congestion = pd.read_sql(query_congestion, engine)
print(f"Congestion data rows: {len(df_congestion)}")

# Fetch the number of 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION' sensitive areas within 500 metres of the station
query_schools = text("""
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM sensitive_area sa
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON aqs.id = 14
WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
AND ST_DWithin(aqs.coordinate::geography, sa.geometry::geography, 500)
""")
df_schools = pd.read_sql(query_schools, engine)
mk_schools = df_schools.iloc[0, 0]
print(f"Number of schools: {mk_schools}")

# Fetch the dominant land use zone within 500 metres of the station
query_landuse = text("""
SELECT luz.land_category, SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(aqs.coordinate::geography, luz.geometry::geography))) as area
FROM land_use_zone luz
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON aqs.id = 14
WHERE ST_DWithin(aqs.coordinate::geography, luz.geometry::geography, 500)
GROUP BY luz.land_category
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
df_landuse = pd.read_sql(query_landuse, engine)
mk_dom_landuse = df_landuse.iloc[0, 0]
print(f"Dominant land use: {mk_dom_landuse}")

# Calculate the mean NO2 for June 2025
mk_no2 = df_no2['no2'].mean().round(1)
print(f"Mean NO2: {mk_no2}")

# Calculate the mean congestion index for rush hours 08 and 09
mk_rush_ci = df_congestion['congestion_index'].mean().round(2)
print(f"Mean rush hour congestion index: {mk_rush_ci}")

WITH station_buffer AS (
    SELECT ST_Buffer(coordinate::geography, 500) AS buffer
    FROM air_quality_station
    WHERE id = 14
),
relevant_segments AS (
    SELECT rs.id, rs.geometry, hrt.congestion_index
    FROM road_segment rs
    JOIN hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt ON rs.id = hrt.road_segment_id
    WHERE hrt.datetime >= '2025-06-01 08:00:00'
    AND hrt.datetime < '2025-07-01 09:00:00'
    AND hrt.congestion_index IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM station_buffer sb
        WHERE ST_Intersects(rs.geometry::geography, sb.buffer)
    )
)
SELECT AVG(congestion_index) AS mean_congestion_index
FROM relevant_segments
""")
df_rush_ci = pd.read_sql(query_rush_ci, engine)
mean_congestion_index = df_rush_ci['mean_congestion_index'].iloc[0].round(2)

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM sensitive_area sa
JOIN station_buffer sb ON ST_Intersects(ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography, sb.buffer)
WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
""")

),
intersection_areas AS (
    SELECT luz.land_category, SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(luz.geometry::geography, sb.buffer))) AS total_area
    FROM land_use_zone luz
    JOIN station_buffer sb ON ST_Intersects(luz.geometry::geography, sb.buffer)
    GROUP BY luz.land_category
)
SELECT land_category
FROM intersection_areas
ORDER BY total_area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
df_landuse = pd.read_sql(query_landuse, engine)
dominant_landuse = df_landuse['land_category'].iloc[0]

# Verify and assign the final values
print(f'VERIFY mk_no2: stored=None | independent={mean_no2} | final={mean_no2}')
print(f'VERIFY mk_rush_ci: stored=None | independent={mean_congestion_index} | final={mean_congestion_index}')
print(f'VERIFY mk_schools: stored=None | independent={num_schools} | final={num_schools}')
print(f'VERIFY mk_dom_landuse: stored=None | independent={dominant_landuse} | final={dominant_landuse}')

mk_schools = num_schools
